notes.title: Update #10 - New effects and fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/f8470509b0014f657523184344510f4b9a4f6b0b.png[/img]

Hi, Spacelanders,

Here is some fresh and juicy update for Spaceland:
[list]
[*] New effect for destroying crystal barrier
[*] Improved effect for laser beam in boss fight
[*] Earthshake and stones added on third phase of secret boss
[*] Visual effects for secret gadget in the mission 29 added
[*] New animation for selecting soldiers
[*] Alternate ending comix expanded with new picture
[*] Bug with trying to access first secret door fixed
[*] You need more chips and reputation to reach secret ending
[*] Other bugs and improvements
[/list]

Stay tuned. More to come. To infinity and beyond.

notes.title: Update #8 - Online Co-Op
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/005630e2c794ce87fdd2b93ac846d64ce39b94ab.png[/img]

Hi Spacelanders.


Good news everyone! We have finished all three online modes:
[list]
[*] Online Duel - Monsters vs Soldiers
[*] Online Duel - Soldiers vs Soldiers
[*] And last but not least - Online Co-Op
[/list]

We now have full support for all of the online modes. We have made more than we promised on launch of our game because many of our players wanted to play Online Co-Op. So hope you like it.

And here are other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug with daily mission "Survive it". You can get medals for speedy completion of this mission
[*] Steam Chat button is renamed to Community button and leads to our Steam community hub. Because not all players accessed to the chat correctly.
[*] PvP freezes fixed
[*] Zone of click on character portraits is expanded. Thanks to our player Adobe that mentioned this issue
[*] Other minor improvements
[/list]

Thanks for playing and stay tuned. We are working hard to make Spaceland better and still determined to fulfill our post-release plan. Hope you appreciate it.

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Update #7 - Daily Missions Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/d27795b284a57e68536caf37afe1911f0c75f0bf.png[/img]

Hi, Spacelanders.

We have reworked our Extra Missions into Daily Missions Mode.
[list]
[*] You get reputation for completing the daily mission
[*] You get chips in daily mission that you can use in main scenario to upgrade your heroes. If you want to upgrade more soldiers - you could use daily missions for it
[/list]

Hope it will make completion of Daily Missions more interesting. More of that we have fixed some bugs and issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/45e403e96e567a6b90bfc1996a9876d350b989cb.png[/img]

We wish you a merry cristmas and happy new year. Some new updates will appear in 2020 too.

Best regards,
Tortuga Team.

notes.title: Update #5 - New online arenas
notes.notes:
Hi Spacelanders,

We have released update 1.1.1!
[list]
[*] Two new online arenas. Duel on bridges and Duel in closed room. Say us in comments what arena are your favourite. 
[*] Last skill of Gordon fixed. Plasm pistol got 20 damage instead of 20%
[*] Bug with Shaman fixed. https://steamcommunity.com/app/1021070/discussions/0/1629665087694256121/

[*] You can see last battles in Multiplayer to understand who win last duels
[*] Preparations for Extra Missions. Some of them you can play if you have finished the game

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829109/8fcee0ba507e07885d4a8359f5e0d4e24ec2a503.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #3 - Chips improvements
notes.notes:
Hi Spacelanders! Here is new update for you.

[list]
[*] You can drop all your upgrades and get chips bask.
[*] You can get chips for chat with your teammates on your ship.
[*] Gordon plasm gun shows correctly in the workshop.
[*] You center the camera on the hero when click on him once again.
[*] Torvald's bug with grenade launcher fixed.
[*] New indicator for spots completed on normal difficulty.
[*] Bug with infinite waiting of enemy turn fixed.
[*] Bug with wrong stun visuals fixed.
[/list]

We hope that you enjoy the game! Don't forget to leave any feedback, ideas or just thoughts about Spaceland in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1021070/discussions/]official Steam Discussion forums[/url]!

notes.title: Update #2 - More hotkeys
notes.notes:
Hi Spacelanders!

Here is another pack of improvements and fixes for you:
[list][*] Medic Bug fixed. https://steamcommunity.com/app/1021070/discussions/0/1629665087686501291/
[*] Interfaces close by ESC button
[*] Dialogues and cutscenes close by ESC button
[*] Button for skip cutscenes in the upper-right corner
[*] Space skips one snap of dialogue
[*] Scientist uses armor properly in Mission 27
[*] Encyclopedy fixes. Some buttons with question mark removed
[*] New Hotkeys added. "1" - change weapon. "2-5" - select abilities. Arrows - navigate battle arena. Hold Shift - speed up navigation by Arrows and WASD.
[*] Bug with infinite time for AI turn fixed
[/list] 

Thanks for playing Spaceland. Stay tuned for our another improvements!

Best regards,
Tortuga Team.
